summary: Implemented and fitted a 33-feature pre-match three-class logistic model using 2399 observed matches; exported 641 experimental probabilities. Same-day results excluded, prior-season/league shrinkage supports early-season and unknown-history teams. Current season-final passing snapshots excluded. Model acceptance remains pending independent review and human acceptance.

evidence.description: Executable feature builder, fitting and frozen temporal evaluation
Future prediction model, weights, scaling, feature list, not adopted
Frozen 2023/24+2024/25 evaluation model distinct from full-data future model
Validation selection and untouched 2025/26 plus current season monitoring; per league comparison
Input hashes, prior assumptions, feature exclusions and date policy
Per-match pre-date features and current-season last-five evidence
641 actual stored fixture probabilities, no invented future results, observed records through 2026-09-20
11 author checks; not independent model approval

issues: No historical prematch passing accuracy/count snapshots; these were excluded rather than replaced with zeros.
PPDA is a pressing proxy, not passing accuracy. No lower division history available for promotion adjustments.
Missing previous season history does not prove promotion. Initial neutral league assumptions are disclosed.
Latest observed match is 2026-09-20; fixture dates are Understat source dates with unverified kickoff timezone.
Current LaLiga accuracy 43.48% is below frequency baseline 44.93%; overall current calibration error is higher than historical holdout.
All 641 forecasts share one stored snapshot; future fixtures require refreshed inputs before operational use.
No scoreline model fitted. Any displayed score is illustration, not a predicted score.
Independent review and participant confirmation are not performed by this producer; model_accepted remains false.
